$comment: What every setting in the `stack` section does, its type and allowed values; defaults are in config.json beside this file (the section itself). See scripts/pipeline/lib/settings.mjs.

stack.poolSize.does: How many copies of the app stack (slots) may run at once.

stack.slotStride.does: How far apart two slots' host ports are.

stack.stackMemoryMb.does: Memory one app stack copy is counted at.

stack.composeProject.does: The compose project name of slot 0 (slot n appends `-n`).

stack.imageTag.does: The tag given to images named through an environment variable (slot n appends `-n`).

stack.stateDir.does: The stack's generated state (env file, build stamps, slots).

stack.composeFile.does: The compose file, relative to the repository.

stack.envTemplate.does: An env file listing every variable the compose file needs.

stack.env.does: Fixed, test-only values written to the stack's env file.

stack.ports.does: Host ports per name: `base` on slot 0 and the `env` variable the compose file publishes it with.

stack.urls.does: URLs for people, tests and agents, with `{port:<name>}` placeholders.

stack.baseUrl.does: The URL tests start from (`null`: the first).

stack.services.does: Compose services whose images are built from the repository, with their inputs.
stack.services.allowed: names to `{ inputs, image, project }`, or a list of inputs

stack.resolver.does: A module that computes more inputs per service.

stack.build.all.does: The shell command that builds every image (`null`: `docker compose build`).

stack.build.service.does: The shell command that builds one image (`{service}`).

stack.build.serviceNext.does: The command for the second and later services of one rebuild.

stack.build.env.does: The environment of the build and publish commands.

stack.build.envFile.does: The env file `build.all` writes with the image names (or a list of candidates).
stack.build.envFile.allowed: a file name, or a list of them (`*` allowed)

stack.build.builtTag.does: The tag the build gives its images before they are retagged per slot.

stack.build.inputs.does: What the build hashes to decide whether the images are current.

stack.build.exclude.does: What the build's hash leaves out.

stack.publish.does: A shell command that generates the compose file into `{out}`.

stack.publishAppHost.does: The application host project the compose file is published from.

stack.publishOverrides.does: The test-only overrides of a published stack.

stack.leaseTtlSec.does: How long a borrowed copy of the app stack stays reserved without a renewal.
